direction-type.words: The system of kinship keys by Rimsky-Korsakov:
(For key "С" this is d, e, F, G, a, f)
(For key "a" this is C, d, e, F, G, E)
(For key "С" this is A♭, A, B♭, B, D♭, D, E♭, E, g, b♭, b, c)
(For key "a" this is f, f♯, g, g♯, b♭, b, c, c♯, B♭, B, D, A)
(For key "С" this is c♯, d♯, F♯, f♯, g♯)
(For key "a" this is D♭, e♭, E♭, G♭, A♭)
Modulation to the keys of the second degree of kinship
through the keys of the first degree of kinship
Exercise: compose modulations in the keys of the second degree of kinship.
